title: 你希望我们怎么称呼你？

en.title: What name should we use for you?

title: 你目前处于哪个学习或工作阶段？

en.title: What is your current stage of study or work?

title: 你学习的专业或主要领域是什么？
help: 未定专业可写感兴趣的方向；年级选填。

en.title: What is your major or main field of study?
en.help: If undecided, share a field you are considering. Year of study is optional.

title: 你对哪些领域感兴趣？
help: 最多选 3 项，不限于专业或职业。

en.title: Which areas interest you?
en.help: Choose up to 3. These can be outside your studies or career.

title: 你对未来职业方向的想法是？
options: 已有比较明确的目标行业或岗位
有几个感兴趣的方向，正在比较
大致知道喜欢做什么，但还不知道对应什么工作
还在探索，希望接触更多可能性

en.title: How clear are you about your career direction?
options: I have a clear target industry or role
I am comparing a few possibilities
I know what I enjoy, but not which jobs fit

title: 你想探索哪些行业、岗位或工作内容？
help: 可以写具体方向，也可以写“不确定”。

en.title: Which industries, roles or types of work would you like to explore?
en.help: A specific direction or “not sure yet” is fine.

title: 学习或工作之外，你喜欢做什么？
help: 写 2–3 个爱好或活动，例如游戏、运动、购物、旅行、音乐。

en.title: What do you enjoy outside study or work?
en.help: List 2–3 hobbies or activities, such as gaming, sport, shopping, travel or music.

title: 最近有什么小事，让你觉得有个工具帮忙就好了？
help: 写 1–3 句话；不用想解决方案，没想到也可以。

en.title: What is an everyday frustration you wish a tool could help with?
en.help: 1–3 sentences. No solution needed; “nothing comes to mind yet” is fine.

title: 你喜欢哪款 App、网站或数字产品？为什么？

en.title: What app, website or digital product do you like, and why?

title: 你使用 AI 工具的频率是？

en.title: How often do you use AI tools?
options: I have not used AI tools
I have tried them a few times

title: 你用 AI 做过哪些事情？
options: 查找资料、理解概念或辅助学习
头脑风暴、做计划或获得建议
整理文档、总结内容或制作演示材料
写代码、搭建网站或制作小工具

en.title: What have you used AI for?
options: I have not used AI tools

title: 你有编程或制作数字产品的经验吗？
options: 学过一点，但还没有独立做过项目
用 AI 或无代码工具做过简单作品
有编程经验，也做过项目

en.title: What experience do you have with coding or making digital products?
options: Some learning, but no independent project yet
I have made something with AI or no-code tools
I have coding and project experience
Not sure how to describe it

title: 你最希望从这次实战营获得什么？
options: 学会把 AI 用于学习、生活和工作
做出一个可展示的产品或作品
学会发现需求、判断和验证想法
探索职业方向或创业机会
legacyOptions: 学会把 AI 用于学习和日常生活
从零做出一个可以使用的产品
学会发现需求、访谈用户和判断产品想法
提升设计、内容创作或表达能力
了解 AI 如何用于不同职业和工作场景
获得可以在实习或求职中展示的项目经历
尝试创业或验证一个想法
认识伙伴，体验合作做项目
探索自己喜欢什么、擅长什么

en.title: What would you most like to gain from this bootcamp?
options: Use AI in study, daily life and work
Build a product or project I can show
Identify needs and evaluate or test ideas

title: 还有什么希望导师提前了解？
help: 例如项目想法、期待或担心。

en.title: Anything else you would like your instructors to know?
en.help: For example, a project idea, hopes or concerns.
